summary: Tower Semiconductor filed a 6-K furnishing a press release announcing its participation in ECOC 2026, held September 21-23, 2026 at FYCMA, Malaga, Spain, booth #C1014. The company will showcase high-volume silicon photonics and SiGe BiCMOS platforms for AI infrastructure, datacenter and telecom optical transceivers, NPO/CPO, DWDM lasers, optical circuit switching, FMCW LiDAR and quantum computing. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory mechanic is disclosed. This is a routine marketing and conference-participation announcement, not a special situation, offering no risk-arb angle.
